# The Best Digital Asset Management Platforms

![Colorful spiral staircases on white buildings, with a large orange staircase in front and green and blue ones receding behind it.](https://www.orangelogic.com/hubfs/stairs3-tight.jpg)

**The best digital asset management (DAM) platforms in 2026 are Orange Logic, Stockpress, Frontify, CELUM, Acquia DAM, MediaValet, and Tenovos.** Orange Logic ranks first because it runs asset management, video, and rights for many teams on one governed platform. The other six each fit narrower use cases. Stockpress suits small and mid-sized teams that want a self-serve DAM, Frontify suits brand teams that want guidelines and templates alongside their assets, and CELUM suits European retail and manufacturing brands managing product content. Acquia DAM suits websites built on Acquia and Drupal, MediaValet suits Microsoft-centric marketing teams, and Tenovos suits consumer brands focused on content analytics.

_Orange Logic wrote this guide. We compared each platform on the five criteria below using publicly available information and published analyst evaluations._

## What makes a digital asset management platform the best?

The best DAM platform is the one you won't have to replace when your requirements change. Most replacements happen because a platform can't absorb a second team, a video library, or a new region's rights rules. Five capabilities show whether a platform will last:

- **Scope.** Check whether one platform covers assets, video, and rights from intake through delivery.
- **Configurability.** Ask whether a non-technical admin can change it, or whether every change needs a developer.
- **Governance.** Find out how far down permissions go, ideally to the individual metadata field.
- **AI flexibility.** Confirm that you can choose your AI engine and switch it later.
- **Scale.** Test whether search holds up as your library grows into the millions of assets.

A platform that passes all five can take on new teams, formats, and regions without another replacement project or a second license.

## What are the best digital asset management platforms?

### 1\. Orange Logic

Orange Logic is an enterprise DAM platform that runs digital and media asset management in one system, with workflow, rights, and delivery built in. It's built for organizations where many teams share one library under different rules. More than 9 in 10 Orange Logic customers came from another DAM, and 98% stay. Orange Logic is a Leader in both the [The Forrester Wave™: Digital Asset Management Systems, Q1 2026](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/orange-logic-named-a-leader-in-the-2026-forrester-wave-for-digital-asset-management) and the [2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for DAM Platforms](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/leader-dam-2025-gartner-magic-quadrant).

**Unique capabilities:**

- **One platform.** Manage images, video, and rights in one system, with [workflows](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/workflows) and [rights management](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/digital-rights-management) built in so there are no separate modules to stitch together.
- **No-code configuration.** Add fields, workflows, and portals without a developer.
- **Field-level governance.** Set permissions down to the individual [metadata field](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/metadata-taxonomy).
- **AI engine choice.** Run search and tagging on AWS, Google, or OpenAI, and switch engines without rebuilding your library.
- **Agentic AI in the workflow.** Let [AI agents](https://www.orangelogic.com/agentic-ai-for-dam) tag, enrich, and check assets against metadata and rights rules as they move through review.
- **Media Bridge.** Connect existing on-premises storage without moving files.
- **Proven scale.** Run libraries of tens of millions of assets without search slowing down.

That setup holds up at scale. In its [2026 Wave evaluation](https://www.orangelogic.com/a-forrester-wave-leader-dam-2026), Forrester writes, "Search in Orange Logic's DAM system is based on a multi-engine approach that delivers subsecond response times across libraries." Kyrce Swenson describes the result at Pearson: "We've increased the effectiveness of our search, gained insight on our actual usage, and reduced our costs by 30%."

### 2\. Stockpress

Stockpress is a self-serve DAM aimed at small and mid-sized businesses, and at teams of any size managing growing libraries of images, videos, and documents.

**Unique capabilities:**

- **Self-serve setup.** Organize, find, and share content without the complexity or cost of a traditional DAM rollout.
- **AI search and tagging.** Use AI-powered search, auto-tagging, and face recognition to find assets faster.
- **Collections and Content Portals.** Group assets into Collections and share them with anyone through branded Content Portals.
- **Transparent pricing.** Add unlimited users, regardless of role, on every plan, with pricing published on the Stockpress website. Start on a free plan or a 14-day Premium trial.
- **Limits to plan around.** Expect to pick your tier carefully, since single sign-on and additional branded Content Portals are Premium-only (every plan includes one Brand Portal).

### 3\. Frontify

[Frontify](https://www.frontify.com/en/digital-asset-management) is a brand management platform that combines digital asset management with brand guidelines, templates, and portals. It's built for brand and marketing teams that need approved assets and brand rules in one place, enabling every team and agency to create on-brand work.

**Unique capabilities:**

- **Brand guidelines.** Publish searchable guidelines that both people and AI tools can read.
- **Editable templates.** Turn approved designs into templates teams can edit and produce in batches.
- **Brand portals.** Share guidelines, assets, and templates with teams, agencies, and partners.
- **AI brand assistance.** Check what's on-brand for each market, and auto-tag assets with AI.
- **Limits to plan around.** Expect cloud SaaS on AWS only, with unpublished pricing based on monthly active users.

### 4\. CELUM

CELUM is a European Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform that helps enterprises manage, enrich, and distribute digital assets and product content. Designed for complex retail, manufacturing, and multi-brand environments, it connects content management, collaboration, workflows, AI, and brand management in one platform.

**Unique capabilities:**

- **High-end DAM.** Manage and distribute digital assets at enterprise scale.
- **Content workflows.** Streamline review and approval processes across teams.
- **Product Content Studio.** Centralize and enrich product content for omnichannel delivery.
- **CELUM AI.** Accelerate tagging, search, and metadata enrichment with AI.
- **Extensive integrations.** Connect with Adobe, SAP, SharePoint, Salesforce, WordPress, and more.
- **Limits to plan around.** Expect to scope your package carefully, since CELUM lists capabilities like Product Content Studio and CELUM AI as separate products alongside its core DAM, and pricing isn't published.

### 5\. Acquia DAM

Acquia DAM (formerly Widen) is the DAM inside Acquia's digital experience platform, built for organizations running their websites on Acquia and Drupal.

**Unique capabilities:**

- **Modular apps.** Buy apps such as Assets, Portals, and Workflow separately as your needs grow.
- **Web stack integration.** Connect it natively to the Acquia DXP and Drupal CMS.
- **Video Creator.** Script, voice, and subtitle videos with an AI-assisted editor, sold as an add-on.
- **Acquia AI.** Use Acquia's own engine for auto-tagging, AI search, and video transcription.
- **Limits to plan around.** Expect cloud SaaS only, with the Workgroup tier capped at 50 users and 1 TB.

### 6\. MediaValet

MediaValet is a cloud DAM built only on Microsoft Azure, aimed at marketing and creative teams in Microsoft-centric organizations.

**Unique capabilities:**

- **Storage-based pricing.** Add as many users as you need, since pricing scales with storage on a rate card published in Azure Marketplace.
- **Microsoft integration.** Connect it to Microsoft 365 and other Microsoft tools.
- **Azure AI.** Use Azure AI services for auto-tagging, face recognition, and video transcription.
- **Brand add-ons.** Add Experience Portals, templating, and proofing alongside the DAM.
- **Limits to plan around.** Expect Azure SaaS only, with no on-premises or hybrid option.

### 7\. Tenovos

Tenovos is a cloud DAM aimed at consumer brands in CPG, retail, and media that want to measure how their content performs.

**Unique capabilities:**

- **Tenovos Glass.** Search and track content use across other platforms, and measure how it performs.
- **Tenovos Connect.** Build integrations without code, or use the low-code studio for custom connectors.
- **Content analytics.** Report on asset use and performance inside the DAM.
- **AWS hosting.** Run it on AWS, with a listing in AWS Marketplace.
- **Limits to plan around.** Expect to ask for details, since pricing, deployment options, and admin configuration aren't publicly documented.

## How do the best DAM platforms compare?

Orange Logic is the only platform on this list that pairs digital and media asset management, rights, and delivery with field-level governance and a choice of AI engine. The table below compares all seven platforms using publicly available information, and it marks any capability a vendor hasn't publicly stated.

|  | Orange Logic | Stockpress | Frontify | CELUM | Acquia DAM | MediaValet | Tenovos |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Platform scope** | DAM, MAM, workflow, rights, delivery in one | DAM with Collections and branded Content Portals | DAM plus brand guidelines, editable templates, and brand portals | DAM plus content workflows, Product Content Studio, and brand management | DAM plus PIM, portals, templates, and workflow as separate apps; part of Acquia DXP | DAM plus Experience Portals, templating, and proofing | DAM plus Glass (cross-platform content analytics) and Connect (integrations) |
| **Who configures it** | Non-technical admins, no code | Self-serve; teams set it up themselves | Not publicly stated; guidelines built from prebuilt content blocks | Not publicly stated | Not publicly stated | Not publicly stated | Not publicly stated; no-code integration builder |
| **Governance depth** | Permissions to the individual metadata field | Not publicly stated at field level | Permissions by team, role, or user, down to the asset level | Not publicly stated at field level | Not publicly stated at field level | Not publicly stated at field level | Not publicly stated at field level |
| **AI lock-in** | Your choice of engine: AWS, Google, or OpenAI | AI search, auto-tagging, and face recognition; engine not publicly stated | AI tagging, search, and brand assistance; engine not publicly stated | CELUM AI; engine not publicly stated | Acquia's own AI; Video Creator is an add-on | Azure AI services only | Engine not publicly stated |
| **Existing on-prem storage** | Connects via Media Bridge, no file migration | Cloud SaaS on AWS | Cloud SaaS on AWS; Enterprise data hosting in the US or Germany | Cloud SaaS on Microsoft infrastructure, operated in Europe | Cloud SaaS only | Cloud SaaS on Microsoft Azure only | Cloud SaaS on AWS; Glass indexes content in other platforms |
| **Proven scale** | Tens of millions of assets | Small and mid-sized teams; storage scales by plan | Brand and marketing teams; storage limits not publicly stated | Enterprise retail, manufacturing, and multi-brand organizations | Workgroup tier up to 50 users and 1 TB; Enterprise tier 10 TB | Mid-market to enterprise; published tiers up to 50 TB | Enterprise consumer brands |
| **Pricing model** | Custom, scoped to requirements | Published tiers, including a free plan; unlimited users on every plan | Custom, based on monthly active users; not published | Custom, not published | Custom, across named tiers | Storage-based with unlimited users; rate card published in Azure Marketplace | Custom, not published |
| **Analyst position** | Leader, Wave and MQ | Not evaluated in Wave or MQ | Contender, Wave; Challenger, MQ | Niche Player, MQ; not evaluated in Wave | Strong Performer, Wave; Challenger, MQ | Niche Player, MQ; not evaluated in Wave | Not evaluated in Wave or MQ |

_Wave = The Forrester Wave™: Digital Asset Management Systems, Q1 2026. MQ = Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Digital Asset Management Platforms, 2025. Comparison based on publicly available information as of November 9, 2026. Vendor capabilities change, so verify current details with each vendor. "Not publicly stated" means a capability wasn't publicly documented at the level needed for a fair comparison, not that it's absent._

## Which DAM platform is right for your team?

Choose for the team you'll have in three years, not the one you have today. Most platforms work well for the first team that adopts them, and the real test comes when a second team arrives with different rules.

| If you need… | Consider |
| One governed platform for many teams, video, rights, and regions | Orange Logic |
| A self-serve DAM with published pricing for a small or mid-sized team | Stockpress |
| Brand guidelines, templates, and approved assets in one place for brand and marketing teams | Frontify |
| Product content and DAM together for European retail and manufacturing brands | CELUM |
| A DAM tied to an Acquia and Drupal website stack | Acquia DAM |
| An Azure-only library priced by storage for Microsoft-centric teams | MediaValet |
| Content performance analytics for a consumer brand, cloud only | Tenovos |

For a step-by-step evaluation, see [how to choose digital asset management software](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/how-to-choose-digital-asset-management-software-2026-orange-logic).

## Frequently asked questions about the best DAM platforms

### What is the best digital asset management platform for enterprises?

Orange Logic is the best DAM platform for enterprises that need governance across many teams. It combines DAM, MAM, rights, and delivery in one platform, configures without code, and sets permissions down to the metadata field. It's a Leader in both the 2026 Forrester Wave and the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant.

### Why do teams replace their DAM platform?

Teams replace a DAM when it can't absorb a change: a second team with different rules, a growing video library, or search that slows as asset volume climbs. More than 9 in 10 Orange Logic customers came from another DAM, and 98% stay.

### How do you avoid replatforming your DAM again?

Buy for the second team, not the first. Ask each vendor to make a configuration change live in the demo, and ask who has to make it. If the answer is a developer or a partner, every new team becomes a project.

### What should you ask in a DAM demo?

Ask the vendor to handle your hardest task live. Have them add a metadata field and set your most specific permissions on it. Ask for the audit trail of an action taken five minutes earlier. Then ask what happens when a second team needs a different workflow.

### Can you replace a DAM without moving every file at once?

Yes. Media Bridge connects existing on-premises storage to Orange Logic without moving files, so teams move over in phases. Orange Logic scopes the replacement with you before you commit.
